title: Jacobi's formula at the identity: d/dt det(1 + t•K) at t = 0 equals trace K
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, ℝⁿ := Rn n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), L(ℝⁿ) := ℝⁿ →L[ℝ] ℝⁿ, and K ∈ L(ℝⁿ). The real function t ↦ det(1 + t • K) has derivative trace K at t = 0. Here 1 is the identity of L(ℝⁿ), det = ContinuousLinearMap.det, and trace K := LinearMap.trace ℝ ℝⁿ applied to the underlying linear map K.toLinearMap.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn n), HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ (1 + t • K).det) (LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) K.toLinearMap) 0
